preconditions.description: The number of sets n must be between 1 and 10,000.
The rank k must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(m) + '\n' + '\n'.join(' '.join(map(str, set)) for set in sets)
postconditions.description: The output must consist of the minimal m followed by n lines of four integers each, representing the sets.
Each set must contain exactly four integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(gcd(s_i, s_j) == k for j in range(i + 1, 4)) for i in range(4) for set in sets)
postconditions.description: All pairs of integers in each set must have a gcd equal to k.
